contract.name: Factory
contract.description: Factory that deploys per-hackathon Escrow contracts, indexes them by bytes32 ID, and manages factory-level ownership.

functions.name: setIntentSpecURI
functions.intent: Sets the machine-readable semantic metadata URI for this contract.
preconditions: Caller must be the factory owner.
risks: URI should reference immutable content; a mutable URI may mislead agents.

functions.name: createHackathon
functions.intent: Creates a new hackathon entry, deploys a dedicated Escrow contract, and returns both the hackathon ID and the escrow address.
preconditions: _ipfsCid should be a valid IPFS CID pointing to hackathon metadata.
effects: A new Escrow contract is deployed; hackathon is stored in mapping and array; emits HackathonCreated.
risks: The caller becomes the organizer of the deployed Escrow; this is irreversible.
functions.agentGuidance: Pin hackathon metadata to IPFS before calling. The returned escrowContract address is needed for all subsequent challenge operations.

functions.name: getHackathonById
functions.intent: Looks up a hackathon by its bytes32 ID and returns its metadata, escrow address, and organizer.
functions.agentGuidance: Reverts if the hackathon does not exist. Check getHackathonCount first if unsure.

functions.name: getAllHackathons
functions.intent: Returns the complete list of all hackathons for enumeration.
risks: May be gas-heavy for very large hackathon counts when called on-chain.

functions.name: getHackathonCount
functions.intent: Returns the number of hackathons created through this factory.

functions.name: transferOwnership
functions.intent: Transfers the factory owner role to a new address.
preconditions: Caller must be the current factory owner.
New owner must not be the zero address.
risks: Irreversible. The previous owner loses all factory-level privileges.
functions.agentGuidance: Double-check the new owner address; there is no confirmation step.

events.name: HackathonCreated
events.description: A new hackathon was created and its Escrow contract deployed.

events.name: OwnershipTransferred
events.description: Factory ownership was transferred to a new address.

invariants: Each hackathon ID is unique; duplicate IDs are rejected.
The factory never holds user funds; all funds go to deployed Escrow instances.
